Documentation/Getting started

Contributing

Stable Engine Doppio Last verified: 2026-11-18

The rules that keep the engine, the Rust editor and the documentation consistent, plus the exact commands a pull request must pass.

Ground rules#

  1. C++20, CMake 3.20+ and SDL3 in the engine; Rust 2021 + Iced 0.14 in Doppio. Match the style of the file you edit.
  2. Minimal diffs — one concern per change; no drive-by refactors.
  3. Tests first — add or update a test when behaviour changes.
  4. No frontend code in the core — caffeine-core has no ImGui, panels or editor state. Frontends talk through libcaffeine-capi.
  5. No plugin code in the engine — plugin sources live in doppio-plugins.
  6. Documentation is HTML-first — see DOCS_STYLE.md.

Workflow#

bash
./scripts/submodules.sh
./scripts/build.sh release
cd doppio && cargo build -p doppio-ui

Before opening a pull request:

bash
cd build && ctest --output-on-failure
cd ../doppio && cargo test
cd .. && ./scripts/check-rust-ui.sh
git diff --check
cmake --build build --target audit-plugin-coupling

check-rust-ui.sh includes formatting, tests, clippy, the core/ImGui coupling audit and the headless UI flows. A new user-visible behaviour also needs a flow in doppio/tests/ui-flows/.

Editor changes#

  • Add a UiId and a CATALOG entry for every interactive widget (doppio/crates/ui/src/uikit/id.rs).
  • Route mutations through Messages and App::update; panels only compose components.
  • Record an undo step with App::commit for every editing command.
  • Keep the viewport non-blocking: render offscreen and poll the readback.
  • Expose agent-facing commands as Message-returning actions in main/agent.rs.

Plugins#

Add or change plugins in the doppio-plugins repository. The engine owns the public SDK (include/caffeine/plugin/) and the host; the archived C++ editor is reference only. See Writing a plugin.

Documentation#

  • English lives under caffeine-website/content/en/docs/; Portuguese mirrors the same paths under content/pt/docs/.
  • Every page starts with a title, a doc-meta strip and a short lede.
  • Screenshots come from the headless driver, never from a desktop screenshot.
  • Update the capture flow in doppio/docs/flows/ when the UI changes.
  • Run the two audits:
bash
cd caffeine-website
python3 scripts/audit-docs.py --include-engine
python3 scripts/audit-docs-i18n.py

Commit style#

Use a short imperative subject and explain the why in the body. Do not commit build artifacts, local configuration or generated caches. A documentation change should update the English page, its Portuguese mirror and any images in the same commit.
